Title: 악당의 엄마가 되어버렸다 1 [Agdang-eui Eommaga Dweeobeoryeossda 1] (I Became the Villain's Mother [Webtoon], Season 1)
Author: NOT A BOOK

Title: 악녀를 죽여 줘 1 [Agnyeoreul Jugyeo Jwo 1] (Kill the Villainess [Webtoon], Season 1)
Author: Haegi
My Review:
Season 1 Chapters 1-44 completed!

Eris is so refreshing to see. She migrates into this new world as a Villainess from the novel she read recently. She repeatedly wants to return home as the life she has in this novel is harsh and not at all warm like what her previous life had been like. Though her previous family doted more on her younger brother and she resented her parents for it, it wasn't a bad life. She dearly misses her mom's food and cries about it. She takes action trying to die to return, but the novel passes it off as another subplot in the story and she continues to evade death.

Throughout the entirety of the webtoon. Eris seeks a way out of the world and discovers that there are characters that had not been in the novel's premise that built up to the moment she came into the world. It's most surprising that her maid, Emma actually figured out that Eris was not "Eris". Her ticks and habits, way of speaking, and mannerisms all changed... But she still stood by Eris' side. It may have been in hopes of one day having her Lady back, but I choose to see it as Emma knowing that Eris wants the same thing as to disappear like her previous lady. Emma understands and sympathizes that Eris is in a harsh world with no one by her side except for her so she sticks by her loyally.

Anakin is an interesting person. He is most definitely endgame, but only time will tell. I do wish that things will get better for Eris and him eventually.

The female lead Helena is so complacent it annoys me. She gets used and just lets it happen. Her lack of being proactive in the story is why Eris and her are in such a position. I don't think anyone actually loves Helena, nor does she. It's just unfortunate that her inability to make decisions and take action are the reason why, she is being manipulated into a puppet for everyone to use. Her role as a smiling beautiful heroine just makes me sick. She chose to forgive Eris for all she's done? No one needs that forgiveness, in fact spite her! Do something! Helena do something more than let the world walk all over you.

The Empress is pitiful but her reasoning to torture Eris just to spite her father is useless and she should have known. Even Eris knows, her father never realized that his daughter changed until she mentioned it. Eris's father never loved either the original Eris or the current her. If he had, the engagement would have been called off a long time ago, but he allowed the world to kill his daughter.

The Crown princess is s***. He claims that Helena is both of their friends but he doesn't even treat Eris like she is his friend from childhood. He doesn't listen to her explanations. He doesn't give her any face (respect) nor does he ever acknowledge that she isn't the one manipulating his pov of her. That day of the debut he looked to Eris immediately after entering. Piece of S*** was looking to see Eris' reaction, but she gives no f***s about his actions. I hate him the absolute most.

The high priest is going through some trauma for sure. He can't make up his mind, but then also turns his back to Eris as quickly as he comes to a conclusion about her. I don't want to know his further.

Jason. Why do I feel he isn't actually in love with Helena... I don't know just something in my guts telling me he's being misunderstood. But again Anakin best candidate~


Can't wait for season 2... The plot will thicken and it will be a fight against the flow of the story.

Title: Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku, Vol. 1
Author: Fujita
My Review:
"We're together because I love you... and I like seeing you doing things that make you happy." -Hirotaka

**There is also an anime floating out there and its 13 episodes are about 20-ish minutes each episode (well worth the watch!!)**

So this first volume takes a dive into childhood friends Hirotaka and Narumi and it's clear they are the main couple. The other couple introduced to us are very supportive of the main couple though I'm not so sure how healthy their own romantic lives are. They all have their unique hobbies and quirks. Each of them are so memorable and fully fleshed out (I'd love to have friends like them, to be honest).

That being said, this will be a rough read for anyone who is not remotely interested in anime/games/mangas and the overall otaku lifestyle. There are so many references to all of those mentioned above that you really do need footnotes here and there sometimes if you didn't catch the references. Overall I really really love how refreshing and relatable this is. I personally can't call myself a hardcore Otaku but I do love anime/games/manga so as a young adult trying to find love in this life I find it nice to see it through a different lens. There are so many animes out there that start romance pursuits from a high school setting so this really is different in the sense that they are all adults working, making money, and drinking legally. It's a different but comfortable atmosphere.

Title: Komi Can’t Communicate, Vol. 1
Author: Tomohito Oda
My Review:
There's an anime adaption on Netflix that I highly recommend! It so beautifully shows the pivotal moment of Tadano and Komi meeting and conversing together.
People with social anxiety have trouble communicating with others, but just because they struggle to form that connection it does not mean they don't want to converse with others. Komi suffers from severe social anxiety and it comes off as a cold ice queen vibe to others, except for Tadano. He is exceptionally talented at reading the room to the point Osana Najimi (a side character who people don't really know the gender of) thinks Tadano's a mind reader. It's very cute and its definitely a fun read. This is one of those typical highschool slice-of-life reads that are fun to binge through so I'll be reading the other volumes shortly after this one.
Komi is a sweetheart and so precious. Tadano is surprisingly dense romantically though he seems to be clever and adept in social settings otherwise. I'll be rooting for them <3

Title: 남주를 주웠더니 남편이 생겨버렸다 [Namjureul Juweossdeoni Nampyeon-i Saenggyeobeoryeossda] (I Found a Husband When I Picked up the Male Lead [Novel])
Author: Choam
My Review:
4/5 -lost a star only due to the issue of finding it hard to find all the translations in a single place with consistency. I really do believe this deserves the full 5/5 if some of the issues with plot holes are answered (I'm sure they were answered in the official but the translations just don't give it justice)

Main female lead of the current timeline is Werazel (Lizelle) who uses her limited knowledge of the world she's in to change her circumstances. She searches and finds the lost nephew of the Duke of Halos in order to get a reward and payback all her family debt (The family debt was all original Werazel's fault as she was pretty vain and loved luxury, but after coming into the world in Werazel's place our female lead does a complete 180 on her priorities.) The nephew (Rapellion Halos or Lapel or Rapel) is the OG Male lead, but this is another timeline in the story and instead is just really attached to Werazel like a baby duck.


Lizelle cares for Rapel a lot and soon becomes attached to him and begins to find it harder to separate from him. They wouldn't have to separate, but there's someone coming in between them. The Duke Chester Halos cares for his nephew who is the only remaining family member of his deceased brother. Chester's brother was planning on bringing his son and wife to visit the duke after a long time, but their carriage is met with an accident and Rapel is missing. It's later revealed that the carriage accident was in fact planned murder.. and that Rapel is in serious danger bringing the urgency of finding little Rapel priority.

Chester doesn't like Lizelle at first because he suspects she is just a scammer (she's again just known for her vanities and luxuries spending) and is using a random child to gain money as the reward for finding the missing nephew. While that isn't completely wrong, it's not exactly right either. Werazel and the Duke slowly become closer (with the help of a common topic Rapel). When the Duke secretly figures out that the child Lizelle brought was truly Rapel, he regets his rude actions towards Lizelle and slowly starts to open his heart to the both of them.

When Lizelle is informed that Rapel is the true heir of Halos, she is heartbroken to have to leave Rapel and Rapel takes the news worse. Rapel loves Werazel like she's his mother and Duke like his father so having to part with either is traumatic. The Duke then comes up with the brilliant plan to marry Werazel for her to continue staying together with Rapel and him (he's fallen head over heels for her at this point and is completely blinded to love now haha). Werazel agrees under a few conditions and hence starts the story of romance and lurking mystery and murder.


I recommend reading this if anyone hasn't already. It's a bit hard to find all the chapters but definitely one of the cuter books of the year. Rapel is a precious sweetheart that should never endure any more pain in this world. Lizelle deserves the world, she really is so good with children (no wonder Chester fell for her so quickly she really is such a pure soul). Chester has gone through so much losing his family and the meaning of a loving family from a young age... He deserves to have Rapel and Lizelle by his side for a long time.

Title: I Became the Wife of the Monstrous Crown Prince
Author: 꿈결나무

Title: The Maid and The Vampire
Author: Yi Dolce
My Review:
chapters 1-51 main story and 25 side story chapters completed!

Though I do love the plot I don't like how open ended it left most of the plot for us readers. The characters are all charming though as the webtoon states themselves, the main leads are so selfish. Having lasted so long in a relationship was a miracle in itself. Isekai novels and webtoons just leave this bad taste in my mouth after having the character discover themselves in a new environment. I don't like that they are just so willing to drop everything they cherish and readily accept the world as their final home. They don't miss their family for as long as you'd think and barely recall them outside of flashbacks.

Millard's background isn't exactly fleshed out at all but his actions and how he is from the start to the end definitely show his character. The little tidbits we get from him recalling his past and the flashbacks don't do much justice to explain how bad the upbringing must have been for him to make a poison teapot to poison himself hoping to slowly die.

This is a sweet romance, but very selfish and self-obsessed type of love. They love each other if the other loves them. They need each other but sacrifice nothing in exchange. It's not compromising at all to say the least. Though I enjoyed it, I probably will not refer to this webtoon for anything outside the cute moments of them falling for each other.


The side story for Ezra just upset me. Ezra's childhood was somehow even better shaped out than Millard's was. It started off with Ezra being unable to see anything because everyone was too bright and his fear of Millard because he was complete darkness. Ezra grew up in an environment where ever Ezra goes someone will want something from him. With the Duke and Duchess he doesn't have that. They don't want anything from him and he loves the feeling of being welcomed home. I find it absolutely heartbreaking that we don't even know why both Duke and Duchess want him in high priest's seat but that it will surely take him far away from his family. He deserved more than that lack luster ending. We don't even see him in the last side chapter!! >_< I'm sad.

Title: I Choose the Emperor Ending, Season 1
Author: NOT A BOOK
My Review:
Season 1 chapters 1-54 completed!

The story setup is much more acceptable to me than most other isekai webtoons out there. There's an explained reason why Reno gets into the world she does, but also provides much-needed information about her life before the change. I do love how the characters are explored and given additional background and personality. It felt like the world was shifting and growing the further Reno invested time into it.

The only thing I could say I dislike had to be how misinformed us readers are about the world's endings and plot. The pieces of the plot fall together almost haphazardly to move the plot along. I'm not sure if this is a problem with the translation but it is very choppy moving from one plot point to another.

I also do have a place in my heart for Cain. It breaks me to see how she makes her decision and actually sticks to it.

Title: I Choose the Emperor Ending, Season 2
Author: Jaradog
My Review:
Season 2 chapters 55-115 complete!

I feel a bit cheated, but not entirely at the same time. I would suspect from the cover that Reno would grow out her hair a lot more after having revealed her gender. but no... us readers do not get that. The outfit over even placing the crown on Edward doesn't happen either.

I do like all that happens involving the empowerment of women but seriously it really did hurt to see how it took her so long to get to that realization. I noticed pretty much immediately from how a women's status is looked down on in the world that Reno clearly didn't look to having strong females in her story. She obsessed over her issues, internally trying to fit in, at work and in the world. She has caused such hardships on the women of the world she created. The further she delved into the topic it made Edward seem so so much more shallow in perspective. He grew into a full person through the hardships and loss of many women's lives. It's kinda sickening that that was the literal only purpose of having women in this world. To show Edward could be merciful and learning of equality. I'm just glad she acknowledged that issue and took action to remedy it with influencing and putting women in places of power for the finale. It doesn't make me like Edward more though, I still don't see much in his presence in the story now other than being Reno's partner.

The part that sucked immensely had to be the start of season 2 where Edward's literally unhinged. Cain is more accepting of Reno than Edward but she runs to him without hesitation. In all parts of season 2's starting point, I was convinced Edward was not the one for Reno. He was sheltering her and keeping her silenced, essentially like all the other females of the world suppressed by males. Cain starts off strong helping and supporting however he could, but there's only so much you can do when the one you pine after looks at another.


Cain. I hate that you had to be a second lead. He had more character growth and redemption arc than Edward ever did... You truly deserved better. Cain realized that the way to protect Reno was by getting her closer to the enemy. He risked everything. His love for her and his bestfriend's trust to do it too. He infiltrated the empire and destroyed all the weapons of mass destruction bringing the war to an end. It did help that all the women lead/paved the way for all the knights and supporting aristocrats to attack, but the final blow when Baron knew it was over was after the bombs destroyed the palace. Cain really did do this for her safety in spite of knowing her affection won't be reciprocated. I wish that this was just communicated. So much miscommunication could have been avoided and a much happier end for Cain and other supporting characters could have been achieved. Sigh.

Title: The Emperor's Mask
Author: screw pop pop
My Review:
Read up to episode 58 and my thoughts on it currently are as follows:

The art is quite simplistic and beautiful. It's nothing spectacular, but it is enough to tell the plot and story.

The characters are all a bit flat. The backstories are not touched on and how Lucia (Main Female Lead) acts to being resurrected into a body different from her original in a world where she knows nothing is odd. She literally never thinks about her past until it's discussed (by the protagonist of the story no less... He uses the fact that her body is severed from her origin as leverage against her in order to meet his ends but yeah.. . Literally family means nothing to her as she really doesn't remember or reminisce about them until it comes up as a plot point.
The Main Male Lead convinces the empire that he is just the right-hand man of the unknown/masked emperor and rules without anyone raising flags as soon as the story starts. It's just plot armor at this point to not use brain cells to add two and two together when the entire imperial family looks like him save for just his hair color's sheen.

I continued to read just to see if there would be some spectacular turn of events but by the second poisonings, I realized the culprit(s) without much to go on. Not much of a surprise at all but it is a simple read without too much heartbreaking drama.

Read this if you do like some isekai but don't put too much expectations on it. It has a pretty straightforward plot and the plot armor is strong on this one.

Title: 토템의 영역 1 [Totem-eui Yeong-yeog 1] (Totem's Realm, Season 1)
Author: Soohyeon Lee
My Review:
Steamy... It's a verrrr~y steamy read.

Season 1 consists of 63 chapters and an Afterward by the author. It starts off racing and it never fully slows down. The characters are all very intriguing and the further developed/clearer their backstories get the more impact they make in each scene they show up. It's interesting the motives and aspirations each character has for themselves and what they are doing to achieve them. I liked that every time I found problems with how they approached a situation or each other that the author has not only addressed it through conflict but further exposes the characters' reasonings behind it. The whole plot gets extremely muddled but it keeps a constant pace in discovering hidden truths and false. The season 1 ending in my opinion cuts off in a weird place but hopefully, it will be addressed in the following season.

Title: 상수리나무 아래 [Sangsurinamu Arae] (Under the Oak Tree (Novel), #1-7.75)
Author: Suji Kim
My Review:
Book 1 was a slow-burn character development arc. Maxi and Riftan's communication skills are heart-wrenching to say the least. They communicate with so many misunderstandings still untouched. The overprotective and loving Riftan became suffocating and Maxi's insecurities started to blind her further. The tragedies that unfolded and how their conflicts shaped them were truly beautifully written. I started to relate more and more to Maxi as she started growing into herself. It really is beautiful to watch the two of them cherish each other.

Capturing the despair of wartime is a complex idea to hold onto and show the readers well. Suji did an amazing job of capturing every moment of it. I felt my heart go out to each of the characters and side characters for each of their arcs. I hated some characters before learning to love them. Others I still very much despise (I even laughed at their misery)... So there's a lot you can get out of this. I enjoyed my few sleepless nights of reading this. I'll definitely come back to Book 2 when its done being translated (which may not be soon enough considering the author Suji doesn't want it being actively translated on a different site)

Title: 맛본 김에 꿀꺽! [Masbon Gim-e Ggulggeog!] (Bon Appétit)
Author: Ryuran
My Review:
Bon Appétit's main story is 97 chapters long. It was a delightful and short read. I look forward to the side stories to come!

I was able to read the entire translation on moonlightnovels.com at https://moonlightnovels.com/novels/bon-appetit/ . Thank you to Rosie for being an absolute angel and working hard to translate the whole thing!

A short summary:
After having transmigrated into a fantasy world Luana read about in a typical romance book, Luana lives her days making delicious food as an abandoned princess. Her Kingdom is destined to fall and she's ready to see it happen. She hasn't formed any personal connections to anyone after her transmigration especially as no one stuck around her due to being abandoned as a baby years prior. A seige finally happens in the main story and she gets dragged off to be slaughtered as just another side character. However, that doesn't happen in the slightest.
The fearsome Duke Legion gets distracted by her as she's making too much noise for someone about to die. Turns out she snuck in food to eat before her end. Having nothing more to lose she offers some to the Duke. After he takes a single bite, she's immediately imprisoned apart from the rest of the royals. He assumes she must be a witch and threatens to torture her.
Why he jumps to conclusions so quickly is understood moments later. He can't taste anything. Perfectly good food takes like dirt or sewage making him want to simply eat dirt instead. His family had been cursed by a witch many years ago to never be able to taste again. To his surprise and confusion, he was able to taste Luana's food.

Title: 내 남편과 결혼해줘 (Marry My Husband)

My Review:
Completed up to chapter 59!
The islamophobia others have mentioned is a very bad mistranslation, at least I hope, since the official translation on Webtoon did not phrase it the same way. It wasn't an attack but a different convenient food competitor that released products right before U&K's product launch. This causes skepticism of the company potentially trying to monopolize the product by riding off the success of another or just stealing the idea and promoting it as their own after a leak, which is why the project tanked and was shelved. It was not due to a terrorist attack that foods targeting Muslims had failed. Just bad timing on the product launch.

--
My thoughts on this webtoon:
I liked the consistency of the webtoon being revenge based. It stuck to it and really went hard when it came to taking down the antagonists one by one. I like the unique twist that the plot that had happened in her previous life would still play out, but that fate could be switched to another with the right conditions. That being said Ji Won played Soo Min and her jerk ex-husband Min Hwa into their well-deserved demise. I loved the new side characters a lot and how they added so much depth to the story's plot.

I will say I had feared the worst at chapter 39 but I'm glad Ji Won didn't stoop lower than her enemies to get revenge. They honestly brought it on themselves which is very satisfying.

The two main leads are so dang adorable. I highly recommend reading from the original Webtoon translations at least until the 'food arc'.

Title: トモちゃんは女の子! 3 [Tomo-chan wa Onna no ko! 3] (Tomo-chan is a girl!, #3)

My Review:
Chapter 251-375 + Omake 3

Tomo-chan is the child of summer.

This was a classic trope-filled manga volume. Studying to beat 50% of the school in ranks. Summer shenanigans at the beach and "crossdressing" even though you are that gender, haha. Tomo-chan looks cool but also very cute.

Her outfits are to die for every season of the year it looks like. Her summer looks were giving and poor Jun could not handle any more resets.

Title: トモちゃんは女の子! 4 [Tomo-chan wa Onna no ko! 4] (Tomo-chan is a girl!, #4)
Author: Fumita Yanagida
My Review:
Chapter 376-500 + Omake 4!

Obliterating the other classes and upperclassmen in dodgeball gave me spy x family vibes. It was great and it dug deeper into why Jun seeks strength and what he expects of Tomo-chan's use of it. He mentions how its surprising how he expected her to do one thing by herself without relying on others but she does not. Later he mentions that he hasn't changed at all since they were children looking at Tomo and wanting to be like her.

This brings us to a nostalgic meeting of the two youngsters and the deal they made with a game console. SHE STILL REMEMBERS THIER DEAL AND HAS HIS CONSOLE!! It actually still works so she definitely cherishes it a lot. I love how this dives further into all their shenanigans as children which Jun tells about what made him enjoy hanging out with Tomo in the Karaoke chapter. We even get to see tiny Gundo and she's as sinister as ever. She's a menace and I love her for it.

Jun gets closer to Tomo after going to the dojo and seeing Tomo dazzling as 'he' fought and trained. (Bro probably thought he was gay for years... since he only had eyes for Tomo for the longest time). The bullying incident definitely broke him in more ways than one especially after seeing Tomo smiling with a beat-up face for him and he realizes he can't protect Tomo in the same situation. It's really touching how much they care for each other.

Title: トモちゃんは女の子! 5 [Tomo-chan wa Onna no ko! 5] (Tomo-chan is a girl!, #5)
Author: Fumita Yanagida
My Review:
Chapters 501-625 + Omake 5!

Akemi-san did well sending Tomo-chan out in a yukata for the fireworks festival. I'm glad Tomo put Jun in his place by telling him that she's grateful for his help in some difficult situations whether her fists could handle it or not. His reaction is hilarious cause it looks like his body reacts faster than his mind. That fireworks festival was also the start of something huge snowballing. Tomo saw that Jun would actually understand her now, but she feared the relationship they had would crumble as she is now. My heart.. And Jun finally sees her as someone he can't hurt physically when fighting anymore.

Ah Gundou.. this girl had me scared for this entire volume. She's the schemer helping Tomo organize her feeling for Jun, but it definitely looks like shes holding back. The Construction site scene was intense (For Carol's fiance at least lol). Carol is unexpectedly terrifying but Misaki can be too it seems. (this girl chose to change in the middle of nowhere and caused a misunderstanding with Misaki... but hey alls well ends well.)

Misaki joins the Aizawa Dojo... It's easy to say this will be rough for him.. but he's slowly improving. After training, he's questioned by Carol why he's hanging out more at Tomo's dojo. He takes a huge L when explaining to Carol his affection for Tomo as if it more like a crush than admiration. Carol takes revenge...

Poor Jun is traumatized...Carol definitely could have approached this topic a lot more gently but sure... Take out your anger on Tomo on her best friends... Gundou is mad at her and also takes her revenge later on. There is some good though as Carol makes progress with Misaki and Jun realizes how much he cares for Tomo and his relationship.

Jun really wants to settle his oath and getting stronger than Tomo to get his console back and is surprised to see she still has it in one piece.

Title: トモちゃんは女の子! 6 [Tomo-chan wa Onna no ko 6] (Tomo-chan is a girl!, #6)
Author: Fumita Yanagida
My Review:
Chapters 626-750!

Carol makes up with everyone (even gets her little revenge on Gundou) and gets a boyfriend (honestly her whole family is a case so it only makes sense that her lover is another one..) Speaking of Misaki-senpai, I'm glad he puts his crush on Tomo to rest finally and roots for her and Jun's relationship.

Tomo is so reckless. I'm surprised she hasn't gotten herself hurt more often (in terms of getting colds or a fever). I'm a sucker for falling ill and being helpless to another's help trope if done well. This one between Tomo and Jun was cute and satisfactory. Jun's care for her is slowly increasing more and more and it's endearing.

We get another glimpse of the great gender reveal and Jun's inside thoughts about it and also Tomo's reaction to learning that Jun never knew. It just lowkey sucks that the way Tomo answered the rumors was misunderstood by Jun and he took it as a sign to keep distance for a while till the rumor dies. He was definitely hurt by the indirect rejection and also the jealousy of other guys getting closer to her, but he didn't know how to handle it without making it look like he liked Tomo not long after realizing she was a girl. A YEAR WENT ON WITH THEM BARELY COMMUNICATING.
A YEAR.

This is when he and Gundou's insecurities lead them to want to find a temporary solution to bridge themselves closer to Tomo. This is when they tried to date and how that miserable event went. But hey they are all very close friends now... Jun and Tomo trying to be closer but T_T well you know how that's going considering this is volume 6.

This volume includes the class working students trope + maid cafe trope. It's fun to see and very enjoyable especially when Jun finds out and goes to see her working everyday after that point. This just warms my heart.

Title: トモちゃんは女の子! 7 [Tomo-chan wa Onna no ko 7] (Tomo-chan is a girl!, #7)
Author: Fumita Yanagida
My Review:
Chapters 751-875!

This volume includes a bit of the class working students trope + maid cafe trope from the last volume. It's fun to see and very enjoyable especially when Jun finds out and goes to see her working everyday after that point. This just warms my heart and the fact that used the money to buy a sport watch (and she has a matching one) is just a cherry on top!

The pivotable moments of the volume have to be Gundou's deep regret in giving careless advice to Tomo to change herself in order to appeal to Jun. Gundou knows that Jun likes Tomo for herself and she doesn't have to be insecure about how she is in their relationship as it is to make progress. She comes to the conclusion that she doesn't want to lose Tomo to Jun especially after realizing her obsession to monopolize Tomo continuously over the course of the series (like what happened with Carol when she was first introduced). She doesn't want her friendship with Tomo to fade and lose to Jun.

This of course leads Gundou to avoid Tomo with the excuse of being sick and misses school (during which Carol takes the chance to make Gundou Cinderella of the school festival play). Tomo takes on the role of the prince after realizing that if she didn't take it Jun would be the prince and she refused.

Jun plays the tree. It's amazing. Honestly, he stole the show. It's actually my favorite chapters in the whole series now.

Getting back to the point, but Gundou and Tomo do eventually make up and it's touching.

We get to see the trio's mothers in the audience and it's hilarious to see so many similarities between them and their daughters.


This is also the long-awaited volume so no spoilers after this point! Go ahead and read it yourself!

Title: 검은머리 황녀님 1 [Geom'eunmeori Hwangnyeo'nim 1] (A royal princess with black hair, Season 1)
Author: Ellianyang
My Review:
Season 1 is chapters 1-39! (2/21/2022-2/21/2022)

This manhwa is extremely engaging~ The main female lead is a badass and the male lead is not only a cinnamon roll but equally as awesome as FL is. I love their dynamic so so much and the art definitely does them justice. The secondary characters also have a nice background to them which makes each arc of the main lead's story more entertaining.

The slow build-up for romance is heartwarming as each other is exposed slightly to the other's charms slowly but surely. I fangirl as the small blushes hidden from sight show up in scenes. I enjoy the banter and how in sync they both are. I love how both are just so unwilling to marry the other and go to lengths to work together to stop the marriage. It's nice to see that the two don't magically fall for the other so quickly but actually argue a lot more than compliment. It's good to mention that though they fight with each other, they do compliment and try understanding the other when the time rolls around for it. They are realistic. Probably one of my favorite couples of the year so far (though they aren't even officially a couple yet).

I really love the treasure hunt chapters. It broke my heart to hear such a sad and lovely story and the reward the two of them received. My favorite chapters are definitely from those events that followed particularly the moon festival. Chapter 37 has me fangirling hard! Chapter 39 makes me question just why FL was sent away for marriage, but I'm happy to see the both of them (the leads) warming up to each other while trouble is brewing close by...

These damn psychotic blonde b****es. If only it was easier to put them in their place. *sigh*

Season 2 is chapter 40- 64(currently).

Gosh the plot thickens! Elves and their magical presence and importance to the lands nearby the capital are the next arc! After leaving the festival our main leads travel to see beautiful elves and protect them from the increasing numbers of hunters in the mountainous area. In the process, we find out that someone has been targeting Princess Yurenciene ( or Eurencienne) by summoning a demon... The plot further thickens when the leads stumble into a startling implication of genocide of the elves due to the greed of a handful of people...

The progression isn't as choppy as you would think getting from the peaceful and cute festival to a full-blown history lesson on a once prosperous land that exploited elves which led to a massacre of the species and then finally to a high-speed chase by a bloodthirsty demon... It's exciting and puts you on the edge of your seat.

After math of the arc is one that's expected of such a scandal...

---

Author: Gamon Sakurai
My Review:
I do love when the MC has a twisted personality. It's much better than a picture-perfect and righteous character with boring predictive nature. It makes me feel bad for his sister being "used" in his own twisted ideology and also very curious why the demi-human knows so much of his moments from the past. Their dynamic is strange but makes to give so much to the overall plot.

I wonder how Kai is faring against the world after deciding to help Kei. I wonder how this petition will turn out, but one thing is for sure. Demi-humans are rising up in numbers against the odds.

Title: 山田くんとLv999の恋をする 1 [Yamada-kun to Lv999 no Koi wo Suru 1]
Author: Mashiro
My Review:
Chapters 1-9 Complete!

I love the setup of the manga.
Akane is sweet and straightforward. Her first appearance is quite literally a breakup scene. Honestly, she was left for the better. I can only see her ex dragging her. However, one good thing happened as a result of her relationship! She became a gamer, particularly for Forest of Savior, an MMO game in which she is part of a reasonably active guild. In this guild is a top player Yamada whom she crosses paths with in reality.
There's a lot to say about Yamada through their interactions, but I think he's charming, just not that great at communicating regarding the (romantic) emotional level. I can't wait to see how this evolves further!

Title: 山田くんとLv999の恋をする 2 [Yamada-kun to Lv999 no Koi wo Suru 2]
Author: Mashiro
My Review:
Chapters 10-19 Complete!

I have to say the emotional connection between Akane and Yamada are fairly quick but still a slow burn. I like the new side characters and what they bring to the table. Runa seems to be very unpopular (among readers) when she first appears, but I find her punishment reasonable. She's still young and honestly thought it was an innocent prank that wouldn't hurt Akane. She actually feels genuine remorse and guilt for the entire situation and learns from it by getting lectured by her brother. Runa makes strides to correct her mistakes and resolves the situation by being cooperative and receptive to criticism/punishment. It's the creepy guy I have serious problems with who got off without a scratch for his actions. He still thinks its fine to enter the ladies restroom and offer pain medication overbearingly voiding all personal space... I really fear for Akane in that he doesn't become a creepy stalker.

Yamada on the other hand is looking at Akane in a different light slowly but surely. It's refreshing to see the development from someone so cold and indifferent to a much more receptive and caring person (at least to a girl who's a stranger to him).

Title: My Clueless First Friend 02
Author: Taku Kawamura
My Review:
Volume 2 Chapters 19-29

The volume seemed all over the place but those last few where Nishimura went to visit her grandmother was everything. The way we get to see the two interact in the countryside and how the two go to visit the Nishimura family grave.

Nishimura is paying her mother a visit and it dawns on Takada his actions. Nishimura tells him that her mother passes soon after she was born and she only knows of her mother through stories her father and grandmother tell her. She doesn't know her mom personally but still feels the connection regardless; "even if she feels like her mother's replacement."

Takada then puts two and two together. Her mother passing at her birth and the nickname "Grim Reaper" as if he was telling her that she caused her mother to die. The thought that he might have hurt his close friend was enough to make him cry endlessly. The regret and remorse he must be feeling makes me really really sad for the two of them.

Title: My Clueless First Friend 03
Author: Taku Kawamura
My Review:
Volume 3 Chapters 30-40 Complete!

The field trip was adorable!! ADORABLE! I love the teacher for letting the candy detour slide. The most touching part has to be the friends selfie they all took on the trip. It's really adorable how much Nishimura's dad had worried for Akane in his own way to help her make friends. The way he started to tear up after she sent the selfie was tear-jerking.

I really like Ami-chan and Akane's interactions together. You can tell they are good friends and the misunderstanding was cleared up thanks to being so open-minded on both of their ends. Kasahara's meddling really backfired on her didn't it.. lol.

Title: Mon amie des ténèbres T07
Author: Taku Kawamura
My Review:
Volume 7 Chapters 75-88

Valentine's Day and Kasahara's redemption arc~! She can actually be honorable. I liked the bidding farewell to the sixth graders. It ties down the overall start of the end of the series. I do hope Nishimura's inner beauty never fades or waivers and her self-confidence is regained slowly over the course of the next few volumes. I hope Takada never loses his smile and kindness. It's so sweet as the moments they both experience as starting to ever slowly evolve as time goes on.

It's calling me single in every frame.

Title: Mon amie des ténèbres T08
Author: Taku Kawamura
My Review:
Volume 8 Chapters 88-99 Complete!

They are 6th graders now! The wholesomeness is still there and better than ever (plus some awkward funny moments between Nishimura and Tadaka).

Tadaka embarrassing himself with his own words will forever live rent free in my head. He's starting to make connections and see his attraction to Nishimura for what it is. All in all I'm happy the gang is still together in this new class + more new characters!

I love the emotional and physical development everyone is going through and it's touching to see everyone growing up. I can't wait to see more.

Title: Mon amie des ténèbres T09
Author: Taku Kawamura
My Review:
Volume 9 Chapters 100-112 Complete!
This is Ami and Hino's volume! The secondary couples are always so satisfying to read about also!

There are a few volumes after this one but they don't have their book released on the Goodreads Catalogue.


All in all I just have to say this is a very well written series and filled with lovely characters. If you're interest in the first few volumes I do highly suggest you check out the Anime released this year based on this series. (My First Clueless Friend)

Title: 폭군 남편과 이혼하겠습니다 [Poggun Nampyeongwa Ihonhagessseubnida] (I'll Divorce My Tyrant Husband)
Author: Yoonha Oh
My Review:
Chapter 1-55 Season Completed!

Ok, so I liked this webtoon to a certain degree. The Female Lead is who really sold it for me, the others not so much. The Male lead has absolutely no background other than being a sociopath and using others as he pleases. He only finds obsession with the FL and it's not at all genuine in my eyes. You can't mistake greed for love even if they go hand in hand in situations. I'd much rather her run away as fast as she can and the conclusion to season one is just that.

Robelia is replaced by a Korean office worker in a twist of fate, but of course no one knows that. The two main characters are originally supposed to be the saintess Aisha (girl who came from Korea/another world) and this country's emperor, Alexandro. Robelia exists as the empress in the story only to be replaced by Aisha. It's a depressing existence and even Robelia says that she doesn't care for the emperor's affections since it should belong to the real Robelia, not her occupy Robelia's body. Aisha is sly, but Robelia manages to get the upper hand and support of the Emperor as a strange byproduct. It's completely unwarranted however as Robelia even chases Alexandro out of her bedroom (even as a married couple).

Aisha tries to gain influence by sharing knowledge about Korea to the people, but to no avail, as it backfires on her. Robelia takes advantage of the situation and saved the event by making Korean Dishes. It sends off warning bells in Aisha's head as she begins to suspect Robelia of hiding information about the other world (not yet putting two and two together that Robelia could also have come from Korea).

I don't like how open people are with secrets here. They just outright share whatever they are trying to bury with whoever. Which brings me to the slave Caleb and the duke. These two new additions are giving me a headache. Caleb is getting really suspicious if he wasn't already a red flag offering himself up to a woman much older than him who treats him like a brother. Duke also very much a red flag since he doesn't seem the caring type or even the loyal type.. He reveals his past like it's nothing and he's just a notch below or on par with the emperor with his obsession with the empress and it's been 2 or 3 chapters since he's shown up.

I like the premise but there are better webtoons out there that deal with transmigration/ character replacement and deal with the other characters in a far more satisfying manner. Why did Raelianna End up at the Duke's Manor, The Only Ending for a Villainess is Death, and Kill the Villainess are fantastic choices (I'm sure there's more but these are just perfection).
